    § 02 · The Method

    Designed to train, test, and transform.

    AGORA is built on the conviction that governmental fluency is a strategic capability — not a bureaucratic footnote. Every module pairs business-English precision with policy judgment, civic literacy, and the professional clarity that defines premium government leaders.

    01

    Premium Curriculum

    One hundred modules covering every domain of modern government — from the foundations of public administration and budgeting to AI-powered public services and digital government.

    02

    Realistic Scenarios

    Every MCQ is rooted in plausible professional situations — policy reviews, citizen communication, compliance audits, budget planning — written for international government professionals.

    03

    Automatic Grading

    Instant scoring with tiered performance feedback — from foundational to executive fluency — plus the vocabulary and strategic insight earned from each module.

    04

    Progress That Tracks

    Your completion and scores are tracked live as you move through the program. Revisit your strongest topics anytime in this session, or retake a module to refine your fluency.

    § 03 · The Author

    Brice Gadou

    Business English Expert

    Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international professionals. AGORA reflects his vision: governmental fluency as strategic capability — a multiplier of trust, clarity, and public credibility.

    Designed for the public servants, policy analysts, and government leaders shaping how societies are governed — AGORA is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to communicate in the discipline most responsible for turning public trust into sound decisions.
